brief.CN: Emergency dispatch request: We have reports of giant insect sightings. Probably a prank after so many years, but better safe than sorry.
brief.EN: Emergency dispatch request: We have reports of giant insect sightings. Probably a prank after so many years, but better safe than sorry.
brief.JA: 緊急出動要請です。詳細は不明。７年前に絶滅したはずの巨大生物を見た者がいるとの情報があります。ありえない話ですが、とにかく現地に向かってください。
brief.KR: Emergency dispatch request: We have reports of giant insect sightings. Probably a prank after so many years, but better safe than sorry.
brief.SC: Emergency dispatch request: We have reports of giant insect sightings. Probably a prank after so many years, but better safe than sorry.

brief.CN: Dispatch request from the civilians: Huge monsters have appeared in the city. Be careful; they spit a powerful acid that can cause serious damage. Good luck out there!
brief.EN: Dispatch request from the civilians: Huge monsters have appeared in the city. Be careful; they spit a powerful acid that can cause serious damage. Good luck out there!
brief.JA: 市民から出動要請です。市街地に巨大生物が出現。ただちに現地に向かってください。なお、巨大生物が吐き出す体液は強力な酸です。まともに浴びれば無事では済みません。十分に注意してください。
brief.KR: Dispatch request from the civilians: Huge monsters have appeared in the city. Be careful; they spit a powerful acid that can cause serious damage. Good luck out there!
brief.SC: Dispatch request from the civilians: Huge monsters have appeared in the city. Be careful; they spit a powerful acid that can cause serious damage. Good luck out there!

brief.CN: Gigantic alien creatures have appeared in a residential area. You must protect the civilians!
brief.EN: Gigantic alien creatures have appeared in a residential area. You must protect the civilians!
brief.JA: 住宅地に巨大生物が出現しました。現地はパニック状態です。巨大生物と交戦し、市民を守ってください。
brief.KR: Gigantic alien creatures have appeared in a residential area. You must protect the civilians!
brief.SC: Gigantic alien creatures have appeared in a residential area. You must protect the civilians!

brief.CN: We've lost communication with the Wing Diver team. Head to their last known location and support them as needed.
brief.EN: We've lost communication with the Wing Diver team. Head to their last known location and support them as needed.
brief.JA: ウイングダイバーチームからの連絡が途絶えました。何かがおこったとしか考えられません。現地に向かい、ウイングダイバーを支援してください。
brief.KR: We've lost communication with the Wing Diver team. Head to their last known location and support them as needed.
brief.SC: We've lost communication with the Wing Diver team. Head to their last known location and support them as needed.

brief.CN: Emergency support request: The Wing Diver team is engaged with a very strong enemy and is taking heavy casualties. Their engagement location is not far from here. You are to head out immediately, destroy the monsters, and rescue the surviving Wing Divers.
brief.EN: Emergency support request: The Wing Diver team is engaged with a very strong enemy and is taking heavy casualties. Their engagement location is not far from here. You are to head out immediately, destroy the monsters, and rescue the surviving Wing Divers.
brief.JA: たった今、ウイングダイバーチームからの通信が入りました。救援要請です。ただちに現地に向かってください。各地でウイングダイバーチームが壊滅したとの報告が入っていますが……救援要請のあった場所はさほど離れていません。今なら、間に合うはずです。巨大生物を殲滅し、生存しているウイングダイバーを救助してください。
brief.KR: Emergency support request: The Wing Diver team is engaged with a very strong enemy and is taking heavy casualties. Their engagement location is not far from here. You are to head out immediately, destroy the monsters, and rescue the surviving Wing Divers.
brief.SC: Emergency support request: The Wing Diver team is engaged with a very strong enemy and is taking heavy casualties. Their engagement location is not far from here. You are to head out immediately, destroy the monsters, and rescue the surviving Wing Divers.

brief.CN: A giant insect nest has spread out under the city. We cannot allow it to remain intact! We must begin infiltrating their burrows. Move out immediately and report to the local Ranger team for further instructions.
brief.EN: A giant insect nest has spread out under the city. We cannot allow it to remain intact! We must begin infiltrating their burrows. Move out immediately and report to the local Ranger team for further instructions.
brief.JA: 巨大生物の巣は市街地の地下まで広がっているようです。このまま巣穴を放置することは許されません。これより巣穴への突入作戦を開始します。ただちに出動してください。現地ではレンジャーチームが先導します。共に行動してください。
brief.KR: A giant insect nest has spread out under the city. We cannot allow it to remain intact! We must begin infiltrating their burrows. Move out immediately and report to the local Ranger team for further instructions.
brief.SC: A giant insect nest has spread out under the city. We cannot allow it to remain intact! We must begin infiltrating their burrows. Move out immediately and report to the local Ranger team for further instructions.

brief.CN: Emergency support request: Giant spiders have emerged from underground. They've invaded the city and are attacking civilians. These are a formidable enemy and there are a great many of them, so the Air Raiders are taking point. Air Raiders, move out!
brief.EN: Emergency support request: Giant spiders have emerged from underground. They've invaded the city and are attacking civilians. These are a formidable enemy and there are a great many of them, so the Air Raiders are taking point. Air Raiders, move out!
brief.JA: 地底から蜘蛛型巨大生物が出現。市街地に侵入し、市民を襲っています。ただちに現地に向かってください。蜘蛛型の巨大生物は強敵であり、しかも大群です。これを殲滅するため、支援部隊が出動しています。支援の要請はエアレイダーに一任されます。エアレイダー、出撃願います。
brief.KR: Emergency support request: Giant spiders have emerged from underground. They've invaded the city and are attacking civilians. These are a formidable enemy and there are a great many of them, so the Air Raiders are taking point. Air Raiders, move out!
brief.SC: Emergency support request: Giant spiders have emerged from underground. They've invaded the city and are attacking civilians. These are a formidable enemy and there are a great many of them, so the Air Raiders are taking point. Air Raiders, move out!

brief.CN: Giant insects have shown up in a residential area. EDF soldiers are already engaged in battle there. Please head out to the scene.
brief.EN: Giant insects have shown up in a residential area. EDF soldiers are already engaged in battle there. Please head out to the scene.
brief.JA: 住宅地に巨大生物が出現。すでに先行部隊が交戦中です。すぐに応援に向かってください。
brief.KR: Giant insects have shown up in a residential area. EDF soldiers are already engaged in battle there. Please head out to the scene.
brief.SC: Giant insects have shown up in a residential area. EDF soldiers are already engaged in battle there. Please head out to the scene.

brief.CN: Dispatch request to the port area. Enormous creatures known as 'Retiarii' have been spotted. You're to go investigate.
brief.EN: Dispatch request to the port area. Enormous creatures known as 'Retiarii' have been spotted. You're to go investigate.
brief.JA: 港湾地帯に出動要請。レタリウスと呼ばれる巨大生物が出現したようです。現地へ向かってください。
brief.KR: Dispatch request to the port area. Enormous creatures known as 'Retiarii' have been spotted. You're to go investigate.
brief.SC: Dispatch request to the port area. Enormous creatures known as 'Retiarii' have been spotted. You're to go investigate.

brief.CN: Destroy the giant creatures in the city! The Ravager mothership is approaching the area. Our Air Force will engage the ships. Ground troops, focus on the creatures.
brief.EN: Destroy the giant creatures in the city! The Ravager mothership is approaching the area. Our Air Force will engage the ships. Ground troops, focus on the creatures.
brief.JA: 市街地に侵入した巨大生物を殲滅します。フォーリナーのマザーシップが作戦エリアに近づいており、空軍がこれを迎撃します。地上部隊は巨大生物との戦闘に専念してください。
brief.KR: Destroy the giant creatures in the city! The Ravager mothership is approaching the area. Our Air Force will engage the ships. Ground troops, focus on the creatures.
brief.SC: Destroy the giant creatures in the city! The Ravager mothership is approaching the area. Our Air Force will engage the ships. Ground troops, focus on the creatures.

brief.CN: The mothership is launching flying drones that appear to be targeting people indiscriminately. They act as terrifying slaughter machines that never tire, and they must be stopped before they eliminate all the civilians!
brief.EN: The mothership is launching flying drones that appear to be targeting people indiscriminately. They act as terrifying slaughter machines that never tire, and they must be stopped before they eliminate all the civilians!
brief.JA: マザーシップが飛行ドローンを投下し続けています。飛行ドローンは人間を攻撃する自動兵器。放置すれば、半永久的に人間を襲い続けるでしょう。人類が絶滅するまで戦い続ける恐るべき敵。疲れを知らない殺戮マシンです。絶対に今ここで全滅させねばなりません。
brief.KR: The mothership is launching flying drones that appear to be targeting people indiscriminately. They act as terrifying slaughter machines that never tire, and they must be stopped before they eliminate all the civilians!
brief.SC: The mothership is launching flying drones that appear to be targeting people indiscriminately. They act as terrifying slaughter machines that never tire, and they must be stopped before they eliminate all the civilians!

brief.CN: Ravager transport ships are flying over the city. They must intend to drop more aliens on the population! Head out and protect the civilians from attack.
brief.EN: Ravager transport ships are flying over the city. They must intend to drop more aliens on the population! Head out and protect the civilians from attack.
brief.JA: フォーリナーの輸送船が市街地上空を飛行しています。再び巨大生物の投下を開始するつもりかもしれません。現地に向かい、巨大生物の脅威から市民を守ってください。
brief.KR: Ravager transport ships are flying over the city. They must intend to drop more aliens on the population! Head out and protect the civilians from attack.
brief.SC: Ravager transport ships are flying over the city. They must intend to drop more aliens on the population! Head out and protect the civilians from attack.

brief.CN: The enemy transport ships are continuing their drops and causing more damage. Our aircraft haven't made a dent due to the transport ships' thick armor, but intel may have a solution: We must attack through the open hatches when they make their drops, destroying them from the inside. The hatches are only accessible from the ground, so this mission is in your hands. Take long-range weapons and move out!
brief.EN: The enemy transport ships are continuing their drops and causing more damage. Our aircraft haven't made a dent due to the transport ships' thick armor, but intel may have a solution: We must attack through the open hatches when they make their drops, destroying them from the inside. The hatches are only accessible from the ground, so this mission is in your hands. Take long-range weapons and move out!
brief.JA: 敵輸送船が巨大生物の投下を続けています。このままでは被害が拡大する一方です。しかし、輸送船は厚い装甲に守られており、航空機による攻撃では、効果的な打撃を与えることができません。唯一のチャンスは巨大生物を投下する瞬間。開いたハッチを攻撃し、内部を破壊することです。地上部隊にしかあの輸送船は落とせません。これより、歩兵による輸送船撃墜作戦を開始します。射程距離の長い武器を装備し、出撃してください。
brief.KR: The enemy transport ships are continuing their drops and causing more damage. The hatches are only accessible from the ground, so this mission is in your hands. Take long-range weapons and move out!

brief.CN: We have confirmation that the mothership is traveling offshore and have dropped several 'Hectors' -- walking battle soldiers -- that are attempting to make landfall. We'll set up a shore defense and coordinate with aerial troops for support from above.
brief.EN: We have confirmation that the mothership is traveling offshore and have dropped several 'Hectors' -- walking battle soldiers -- that are attempting to make landfall. We'll set up a shore defense and coordinate with aerial troops for support from above.
brief.JA: 洋上を進む敵マザーシップを確認。マザーシップは、歩行型戦闘兵器ヘクトルを多数投下。ヘクトルは海岸から上陸しようとしています。なんとしても上陸を阻止しなければなりません。これより、水際での迎撃作戦を開始します。これは空軍との共同作戦です。空からの援護が期待できます。
brief.KR: We have confirmation that the mothership is traveling offshore and have dropped several 'Hectors' -- walking battle soldiers -- that are attempting to make landfall. We'll set up a shore defense and coordinate with aerial troops for support from above.
brief.SC: We have confirmation that the mothership is traveling offshore and have dropped several 'Hectors' -- walking battle soldiers -- that are attempting to make landfall. We'll set up a shore defense and coordinate with aerial troops for support from above.

brief.CN: The aliens are digging tunnels to infiltrate the city's underbelly. At least one tunnel entrance has already been confirmed. Alien monsters have been emerging from it, and soon the city will be overrun! We need to destroy this tunnel entrance and stop any more of these filthy creatures from emerging. You are to head out immediately!
brief.EN: The aliens are digging tunnels to infiltrate the city's underbelly. At least one tunnel entrance has already been confirmed. Alien monsters have been emerging from it, and soon the city will be overrun! We need to destroy this tunnel entrance and stop any more of these filthy creatures from emerging. You are to head out immediately!
brief.JA: 巨大生物はトンネルを掘り、地下を移動しているようです。市街地に「トンネルから地上へ出るための出口」が確認されました。そこから巨大生物が次々と出現しているとのことです。このままでは市街地が巨大生物の拠点となってしまうでしょう。地下トンネルの出口を破壊し、巨大生物を地底に封じ込める必要があります。ただちに現地へ向かってください。
brief.KR: The aliens are digging tunnels to infiltrate the city's underbelly. At least one tunnel entrance has already been confirmed. Alien monsters have been emerging from it, and soon the city will be overrun! We need to destroy this tunnel entrance and stop any more of these filthy creatures from emerging. You are to head out immediately!

brief.CN: The Ravagers have begun a serious offensive, attacking several areas simultaneously. Here, they seem to be utilizing a giant walking fortress bristling with weapons that's roughly 200 meters in length. The attack aircraft Midnight has been dispatched to destroy it, but we are to aid them by taking out the fortress' legs, then eliminating any remaining enemies. Ground forces, move out!
brief.EN: The Ravagers have begun a serious offensive, attacking several areas simultaneously. Here, they seem to be utilizing a giant walking fortress bristling with weapons that's roughly 200 meters in length. The attack aircraft Midnight has been dispatched to destroy it, but we are to aid them by taking out the fortress' legs, then eliminating any remaining enemies. Ground forces, move out!
brief.JA: フォーリナーが本格的な侵攻作戦を開始したようです。敵戦闘兵器が各地で攻撃を開始。この地にも巨大な四足歩行要塞が迫っています。全長２００メートル。圧倒的な巨体に無数の武装を持つ恐るべき相手です。これを撃破すべく、戦術爆撃機ミッドナイトの出撃準備が始まっています。我々地上部隊の目的は歩行要塞の足止め、そしてそれ以外の敵を撃破し、被害を最小限に抑えることです。これより歩行要塞撃破作戦を開始します。
brief.KR: The Ravagers have begun a serious offensive, attacking several areas simultaneously. Here, they seem to be utilizing a giant walking fortress bristling with weapons that's roughly 200 meters in length. The attack aircraft Midnight has been dispatched to destroy it, but we are to aid them by taking out the fortress' legs, then eliminating any remaining enemies. Ground forces, move out!

The attack aircraft Midnight has been dispatched to destroy it, but we are to aid them by taking out the fortress' legs, then eliminating any remaining enemies. Ground forces, move out!

brief.CN: We have a confirmed sighting of at least one flying enemy transport ship. We will sortie in the mountain region, where you'll rendezvous with a Ranger team. Make sure to equip long-range weapons to attack the transport ships!
brief.EN: We have a confirmed sighting of at least one flying enemy transport ship. We will sortie in the mountain region, where you'll rendezvous with a Ranger team. Make sure to equip long-range weapons to attack the transport ships!
brief.JA: 飛行中の敵輸送船を確認。山岳地帯で待ち構え、攻撃をおこないます。現地に向かい、レンジャーチームと共同で輸送船を撃墜してください。なお、輸送船を破壊するためには、射程の長い火器が必要です。装備に注意してください。
brief.KR: We have a confirmed sighting of at least one flying enemy transport ship. We will sortie in the mountain region, where you'll rendezvous with a Ranger team. Make sure to equip long-range weapons to attack the transport ships!
brief.SC: We have a confirmed sighting of at least one flying enemy transport ship. We will sortie in the mountain region, where you'll rendezvous with a Ranger team. Make sure to equip long-range weapons to attack the transport ships!

brief.CN: Hector troop variants, probably long-range support models, have begun a ferocious assault, and they're armed with plasma cannons. We have to stop the Hectors from making landfall and destroy them. Good luck!
brief.EN: Hector troop variants, probably long-range support models, have begun a ferocious assault, and they're armed with plasma cannons. We have to stop the Hectors from making landfall and destroy them. Good luck!
brief.JA: ヘクトルの軍団が侵攻を開始。各地で激しい戦闘が始まっています。我々は港湾地帯に現れたヘクトルの上陸を阻止、殲滅します。このヘクトルは強力なプラズマ砲を装備した長距離支援型のようです。十分に注意してください。
brief.KR: Hector troop variants, probably long-range support models, have begun a ferocious assault, and they're armed with plasma cannons. We have to stop the Hectors from making landfall and destroy them. Good luck!
brief.SC: Hector troop variants, probably long-range support models, have begun a ferocious assault, and they're armed with plasma cannons. We have to stop the Hectors from making landfall and destroy them. Good luck!

title.JA: 防御スクリーン突破作戦

brief.CN: New walking-machine variants have reached the city. They continue to march unharmed despite multiple airstrikes; it would seem they have some sort of energy screen that blocks attacks. If we don't find a way to destroy these screens, we won't stand a chance. Ground troops are ordered to find some means of penetrating their shields and taking out these machines.
brief.EN: New walking-machine variants have reached the city. They continue to march unharmed despite multiple airstrikes; it would seem they have some sort of energy screen that blocks attacks. If we don't find a way to destroy these screens, we won't stand a chance. Ground troops are ordered to find some means of penetrating their shields and taking out these machines.
brief.JA: 敵の新型歩行マシンが市街地に接近。数度の空爆にも関わらず、無傷のまま進軍を続けています。このマシンは周囲に防御スクリーンを展開し、攻撃を遮断する能力があるようです。このまま防御スクリーンを破ることができなければ、人類に勝ち目はありません。これより、地上部隊による防御スクリーン突破作戦を開始します。なんとしても新型歩行マシンを破壊してください。
brief.KR: New walking-machine variants have reached the city. They continue to march unharmed despite multiple airstrikes; it would seem they have some sort of energy screen that blocks attacks. brief.CN: The Ravager transport ships have dropped something in the mountains. Intel has confirmed it's a defensive screen. We are dispatching Fencers to the location. Storm Team will provide support.
brief.EN: The Ravager transport ships have dropped something in the mountains. Intel has confirmed it's a defensive screen. We are dispatching Fencers to the location. Storm Team will provide support.
brief.JA: フォーリナーの輸送船が山岳部に何かを投下しました。調査に向かったスカウトチームの報告によると、防御スクリーンが確認されたようです。ただちにフェンサーを現地に派遣します。ストームチームも同行してください。
brief.KR: The Ravager transport ships have dropped something in the mountains. Intel has confirmed it's a defensive screen. We are dispatching Fencers to the location. Storm Team will provide support.
brief.SC: The Ravager transport ships have dropped something in the mountains. Intel has confirmed it's a defensive screen. We are dispatching Fencers to the location. Storm Team will provide support.

brief.CN: The giant insects just keep coming. Things will only worsen as long as they have their nest, so we need to strike them where they live! We will infiltrate the nest from the same point as last time, following the same route. When we're as deep as we can go, we'll attack. We have no idea what to expect, so be careful!
brief.EN: The giant insects just keep coming. Things will only worsen as long as they have their nest, so we need to strike them where they live! We will infiltrate the nest from the same point as last time, following the same route. When we're as deep as we can go, we'll attack. We have no idea what to expect, so be careful!
brief.JA: 巨大生物は増え続けています。地下の巣穴を破壊しない限り、状況は悪化する一方です。再度の突入作戦を敢行し、巨大生物の増殖を止める必要があります。前回と同じポイントから巣穴へと突入。途中までは同じルートをたどり、さらに奥へ。前回到達できなかった深部まで進攻します。何が待っているか想像もつきません。十分に注意してください。

brief.CN: The infiltration was a success, but we're greatly outnumbered, so our casualties could be high. The enemy is on familiar ground, after all, which gives them the edge. Expect an attack at any moment while you're in that nest. Try to use the terrain to your advantage.
brief.EN: The infiltration was a success, but we're greatly outnumbered, so our casualties could be high. The enemy is on familiar ground, after all, which gives them the edge. Expect an attack at any moment while you're in that nest. Try to use the terrain to your advantage.
brief.JA: 巣穴への侵入に成功。想定より多数の巨大生物が生息しており、我々の被害も予想以上です。敵は巣穴を熟知しており、獲物を不利な地形に誘導。そこに足を踏み入れた瞬間を狙って攻撃を開始するようです。なるべく不利な地形にはとどまらないよう注意してください。
brief.KR: The infiltration was a success, but we're greatly outnumbered, so our casualties could be high. The enemy is on familiar ground, after all, which gives them the edge. Expect an attack at any moment while you're in that nest. Try to use the terrain to your advantage.
brief.SC: The infiltration was a success, but we're greatly outnumbered, so our casualties could be high. The enemy is on familiar ground, after all, which gives them the edge. Expect an attack at any moment while you're in that nest. Try to use the terrain to your advantage.

brief.CN: The Ravagers' combat Hectors have entered a residential area. Some EDF units have already engaged them in battle, but a new group of Hectors has arrived, surrounding our soldiers. They're sitting ducks out there! Please go rescue them.
brief.EN: The Ravagers' combat Hectors have entered a residential area. Some EDF units have already engaged them in battle, but a new group of Hectors has arrived, surrounding our soldiers. They're sitting ducks out there! Please go rescue them.
brief.JA: フォーリナーの戦闘兵器ヘクトルが市街地に侵入。すでに先行部隊との戦闘が始まっています。ですが新たなヘクトル部隊が到着。先行部隊は包囲されつつあるようです。このままでは全滅もありえます。ただちに救援に向かってください。
brief.KR: The Ravagers' combat Hectors have entered a residential area. Some EDF units have already engaged them in battle, but a new group of Hectors has arrived, surrounding our soldiers. They're sitting ducks out there! Please go rescue them.
brief.SC: The Ravagers' combat Hectors have entered a residential area. Some EDF units have already engaged them in battle, but a new group of Hectors has arrived, surrounding our soldiers. They're sitting ducks out there! Please go rescue them.

brief.CN: It seems that the Ravagers' army that entered our defense line is under the direct command of the mothership. If we can shoot it down, we can cause a great deal of chaos in their ranks. Currently, the mothership is hovering around the mountain area, flanked by transport ships. Approach from the ground and destroy the whole fleet.
brief.EN: It seems that the Ravagers' army that entered our defense line is under the direct command of the mothership. If we can shoot it down, we can cause a great deal of chaos in their ranks. title.JA: ブルートフォース作戦

brief.CN: The Ravagers are consolidating their forces, and this is the first time they've ever gathered in such great quantities. We can't even count the number of Hectors! But this is good for us. We're ready. We'll attack them head-on and crush them, both from the plains and from the air. The troops will fan out from Zones 1 to 5, while Storm Team will fight in Zone 2. This will become known as 'Operation Brute Force.'

This will be a large-scale infiltration of their tunnels. The first phase will be to look for a route into the depths of the tunnels and secure it so troops can follow.

brief.CN: Ravager combat machines have been confirmed in the mountains and are protecting the dragon teams. We cannot allow their numbers to increase any further! The enemy are concentrating their attacks on our base, costing us the majority of our force and breaking off all contact with our squads. We're now isolated, with no hope for support. We have only ground troops to depend on!

brief.CN: We failed to destroy the quadruped fortress, so now we will attempt to change its route. It is currently nearing our defense perimeter. This fortress is flanked by Hectors bearing particle stream cannons, and its armor is too much even for our Grind Busters. We'll have to attack its weak point, which can only be achieved with ground troops. If we fail, the city will be destroyed. Move out, and good luck!

！！　さらに今入った情報によると、この歩行要塞は粒子ストリーム砲を装備した強力なヘクトルを搭載しているようです。十分に注意してください。

Our plan is to deploy numerous Balams at once and destroy the Erginuses in one fierce battle. We're sending Ranger units as well. Balams are effective against Erginus, but they can't deal with giant insects, so it's up to the Rangers to eliminate those threats.

brief.CN: Large transport ships are dropping drones, and the Wing Divers aren't as effective against flying enemies. We'll have to destroy these giant transport ships from above! Storm Team should equip sniper rifles for the task. Deploy to the top of the buildings, and a defense squad will cover you. Just don't leave your station, even if you encounter resistance! If you're successful, we'll drop a Wing Diver team to kill any remaining giant insects.

brief.JA: 巨大生物の群れが市街地に侵入しました。ただちに現地に向かってください。なお、スカウトの報告によると、飛行型巨大生物、そしてデスクイーンの姿が確認されているようです。十分に注意してください。

brief.CN: Multiple giant insects have been confirmed in the mountains. We must destroy them before they approach the city. Deploy and engage immediately!

brief.JA: 山岳地帯に多数の巨大生物を確認。市街地に移動する前に撃破する必要があります。ただちに戦闘準備を開始してください。これより地上部隊による巨大生物殲滅作戦を開始します。

brief.CN: The Ravagers' Brain has been found. Our aerial units tried to attack it, but the Earth Eaters intercepted them. It's now up to you. There are escorts all around the area, in anticipation of attacks. Destroy them, then take out that slimy cerebrum once and for all. Its weak point is its head, so use long-range weapons that can target its topmost point. The future of mankind depends on the success of this mission!

brief.JA: ついにブレインを発見。しかし、空軍による攻撃はアースイーターに遮られ、失敗しました。これより地上部隊による攻撃を開始します。ブレイン周囲には地上からの攻撃にそなえて護衛部隊が配置されているようです。これを撃破し、ブレインを攻撃します。ブレインの弱点は上部です。射程の長い武器で上部を狙撃してください。この作戦に人類の未来がかかっています。各員の奮闘を期待します。

Perhaps they feel they've won the fight and are trying to finish us off? But we won't stand idly by on the eve of our destruction! All those who can fight, head out and engage! Attack the transport ships from the ground!

brief.CN: The Ravagers' fleet is approaching from the sea and must not be allowed to reach the city. Ground forces will be deployed along the coast and keep them from making landfall. Head out immediately. Consider this a decisive battle -- meaning, don't lose!
brief.EN: The Ravagers' fleet is approaching from the sea and must not be allowed to reach the city. Ground forces will be deployed along the coast and keep them from making landfall. Head out immediately. Consider this a decisive battle -- meaning, don't lose!
brief.JA:
フォーリナーの大船団が海上を進んでいます。これだけの大軍が市街地に侵入すれば、被害の規模は想像もできません。これより作戦を開始。地上部隊は水際に展開。敵を待ち構え、上陸を阻止します。ただちに現地に向かってください。
…………。決死の作戦です。無事の帰還を祈ります。

brief.CN: The Ravagers have started mobilizing an army, most likely as a prelude to a massive attack. And sadly, we're depleted. We can't defend against an all-out attack like this! Though...there may be a way. A surprise attack before the enemy finishes their preparations. Our very survival hangs in the balance. You may join this battle if you wish -- participation is voluntary.

We're outnumbered, almost everything we have has been destroyed, and we have little hope of victory. But we will see this battle through to the end! Join us if you wish to die with honor!

brief.CN: EDF groups across the globe have perished. The only remaining force is on the aircraft carrier Despina. Without support or supplies, we don't have the power to continue the fight. But if we'll be dead tomorrow, then today we make our stand! We're going to attack the Earth Eaters with everything we've got, the last threads of humanity hanging in the balance. The difference in our fighting capacities is dramatic, and failure is almost assured, but we will not give up. Prepare for battle, you brave EDF soldiers. For all you've done and all you have yet to do...I salute you!

brief.JA: 各地のＥＤＦは壊滅。残された戦力は空母デスピナと我々歩兵部隊のみです。支援もなく、補給もつき、戦いを継続する力がもはや我々にはありません。ですが、明日戦う力がないのなら、今日、最後の戦いに挑むまでです。これよりアースイーター破壊作戦を開始します。人類の運命を決める戦いです。いえ……戦力差は圧倒的で、勝敗は戦う前から明白。運命はすでに決まっているといっても過言ではないでしょう。それでも我々は諦めることをよしとしません。ただちに戦闘準備願います。……勇敢なるＥＤＦの戦士たち……これまで、そしてこれからの奮戦に敬意を表します。……ありがとう。
